description:
This game is called Dead Last. Each round, every living player speaks once, in seat order, and then all living players simultaneously point at someone to eliminate. If a strict majority (more than half of alive players) agree on a single target, that target is eliminated. If there is no majority, no one is eliminated. When three players remain, the game enters a Final Negotiation phase: each survivor speaks once, in seat order, and then the survivors simultaneously make one binding offer each, a split of 100 points. If all proposed splits match exactly, the points are distributed accordingly. If they do not match, everyone gets nothing. Eliminated players lose.

During Discussion, use 'speak' to discuss strategy, form alliances, or argue for targets.
During Point, use 'point NAME' to vote for someone to eliminate. Your point names the first player of the game (you and eliminated players included) written as a whole word after the first 'point' or 'pointing' in your reply; a name written with its capital letter is tried before a lowercase one. A point that names you, an eliminated player or nobody does not count.
During Final_negotiation, use 'speak' to negotiate the split.
During Final_offer, use 'offer X Y Z': one whole number for each survivor, in the order the survivors are listed (X is the first-listed survivor's share, Y the second's, Z the third's), summing to 100. You may instead label every share with its survivor's name, in any order ('offer NAME number, NAME number, NAME number'). An offer that names every survivor is read only by its labels: each survivor gets the one number written right before or right after its name, in the same sentence, with no other name or number in between, and each number goes to one survivor (names match as whole words, in any case). If the numbers cannot be paired with the names that way, or can be paired in more than one way that gives different shares, the offer is unclear. An offer that names only some survivors is read in seat order. An unclear offer, or one that cannot be read, counts as a mismatch. The result line shows how each offer was read.

Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Survive to the final round and negotiate the largest share of the prize.
